title: Decision
description: Output schema for FastAgent's System 1 Decision Layer (Laya/Router)

risk.description: Calculated risk of the intended action.

needs_confirmation.description: Whether the policy or confidence requires human confirmation before executing.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability score of the intent classification.

model_used.description: Checkpoint or router branch used (e.g. convaiinnovations/laya-multilingual).

reasoning_tag.description: Short internal classifier tag or rule explaining why confirmation is needed.
